caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic mug positioned upright in the center of the page. The mug has a slightly flared rim, a gently curved body, and a thick, ornate handle with a decorative flourish at the lower attachment point. The handle is attached to the mug at two points, with one end curving downward and outward in a stylized manner. The composition features subtle shading, giving the mug a smooth, slightly reflective surface and suggesting a silvery, gray coloration. The background is blank and unadorned, with only a faint rectangular border framing the mug. Handwritten text appears in the bottom left corner of the drawing, adding a small detail to the otherwise minimalistic composition.
title: Silver Mug
